titulo: Media, society and the environment: Media and social networks

aula.objetivo: Talk about the news, social media, the environment and sustainable habits, understand short news texts, and give your opinion on social issues with B1 vocabulary and structures.

itens.pt: to inform oneself, to find out

blocos.titulo: Talking about the media, step by step
blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: to say WHERE you get your news: «Ich informiere mich im Internet / in der Zeitung / im Fernsehen» (I get my news online / from the newspaper / from TV). STEP 2: «sich informieren über + Akk»: «Ich informiere mich über das Wetter» (I check the weather). STEP 3: to talk about the news: «In den Nachrichten wird über … berichtet» (the news is reporting on… — passive!). Note: «die Nachrichten» is plural, unlike English "the news is". STEP 4: to give an opinion on social media: «Soziale Medien haben Vor- und Nachteile.» STEP 5: use connectors: «Einerseits kann man schnell Informationen finden, andererseits gibt es viele Falschmeldungen» (on the one hand you find information quickly; on the other, there's a lot of fake news). STEP 6: «Falschmeldung» (fake news) and «Quelle» (source) are key words for talking about reliability.

Ich informiere mich über das Wetter.
